entities.summary: Griffin Alexander Canning is an American professional baseball pitcher for the San Diego Padres of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Los Angeles Angels and New York Mets. He made his MLB debut in 2019 with the Angels and won a Gold Glove Award in 2020.
